logging/record#

Log records: when, how important, the message, the logger's context and an optional cause.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

for collected.records() -> record {
    record::Entry::level;
    record::Entry::message;
    record.context().name().string();
    if record.has_cause() { record.cause().text(); }
}

Description#

Log records: when, how important, the message, the logger's context and an optional cause. Loggers make them; destinations write them.
